lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Spot diameter and inter-spot distance increase from the anterior-ventral region toward the posterior-dorsal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like lattice. A prominent vertical band in the mid-flank region appears bifurcated at its dorsal terminus.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single primary longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter, high-luminance spots across its entire visible dorsal surface.
